nextStoryContext: US-004 added the /cam-spec slash command and `cam spec <id>` CLI thin-proxy. Files: .claude/commands/cam-spec.md and templates/commands/cam-spec.md (byte-identical, LLM-consumed so em-dash/emoji fine) reference grill-with-docs skill and specifyIssueOnMain. src/commands/spec.ts is modeled exactly on plan.ts: SpecOptions interface with all injectable deps, runSpec() sends /cam-spec <id> via sendKeysWhenIdle, reuses orchestratorAlive/getOrchPaneId/paneCountMutex. parseSpecArgs in index.ts accepts a string positional id (unlike parsePlanArgs which is integer-only). 16 unit tests in test/commands/spec.test.ts cover dispatch shape, atomic send-keys, no -l, miss path, mutex busy, pane not found. parseSpecArgs added to no-permission-mode-flag.test.ts. embed-vendor regenerated. 1802 tests pass total, typecheck clean, biome lint clean.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-004 is a pure TypeScript thin-proxy using only internal abstractions (sendKeysWhenIdle, orchestratorAlive, getOrchPaneId, paneCountMutex). No external npm library was touched.
